ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the figure “Changes in near-surface average air pressure along two latitudes in a certain month” and answer the following questions. <image1> In this month, between the P and Q regions, which region has the greater average wind force?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a line graph of near-surface average air pressure in a certain month changing with longitude along two latitudes; the vertical axis is air pressure, the horizontal axis is longitude, and the P and Q regions are marked on the figure. Observing the curve changes near the locations of P and Q, near the P region the air pressure changes less with longitude and the curve is relatively gentle; near the Q region the air pressure changes more with longitude and the curve is obviously steeper. Then reason: The magnitude of average wind force mainly depends on the horizontal pressure gradient; the greater the pressure gradient, the greater the wind force. Because the curve in the Q region is steeper, it indicates that this region has a greater pressure gradient, therefore the Q region has greater average wind force.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图为某月近地面平均气压沿两条纬线随经度变化的折线图，P、Q分别标在不同经度段附近。比较P、Q所在区域曲线的陡缓：P处气压随经度变化小，曲线较缓；Q处气压随经度变化大，曲线较陡。再利用“气压梯度越大，风力越大”的规则判断，Q区域平均风力较大。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是某月近地面平均气压沿两条纬线随经度变化的折线图，纵轴为气压，横轴为经度，图上标出了P、Q两个区域。观察P、Q所在位置附近的曲线变化，P区域附近气压随经度变化较小，曲线较平缓；Q区域附近气压随经度变化较大，曲线明显更陡。
再推理：平均风力大小主要取决于水平气压梯度，气压梯度越大，风力越大。由于Q区域曲线更陡，说明该区域气压梯度更大，因此Q区域平均风力较大。

raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: The figure is a line graph of near-surface average air pressure in a certain month changing with longitude along two latitudes; the vertical axis is air pressure, the horizontal axis is longitude, and the P and Q regions are marked on the figure. Observing the curve changes near the locations of P and Q, near the P region the air pressure changes less with longitude and the curve is relatively gentle; near the Q region the air pressure changes more with longitude and the curve is obviously steeper.
Then reason: The magnitude of average wind force mainly depends on the horizontal pressure gradient; the greater the pressure gradient, the greater the wind force. Because the curve in the Q region is steeper, it indicates that this region has a greater pressure gradient, therefore the Q region has greater average wind force.
